NextGenSoftware.OASIS.API.Providers.PolkadotOASIS v2.0.5

Polkadot adapter with network-checked JSON-RPC activation. Storage, signed transactions, token/NFT and bridge capabilities remain under implementation and are not production-certified. See README verification limits.
